blurb:
Experience two of San Francisco’s must-see attractions with one convenient package combining Muir Woods National Monument and Alcatraz Island.

Cross the Golden Gate Bridge on a guided trip to Muir Woods, home to towering coastal redwoods and peaceful forest trails. Enjoy time to explore the park at your own pace, with round-trip transportation from San Francisco and Muir Woods admission included.

On a separate day, take the ferry to Alcatraz Island and discover the history of one of America’s most infamous former prisons. Explore the cellhouse, prison grounds, and exhibits with the included award-winning audio tour.

This package is ideal for travelers who want to experience both the natural beauty and fascinating history of the San Francisco Bay Area.

Please note: Muir Woods and Alcatraz must be visited on separate days.
